steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The geological timescale divides Earth's 4.6 billion year history into eons, eras, periods and epochs

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Principle of superposition: in undisturbed sequences, the oldest rocks are at the bottom and youngest at the top

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Principle of original horizontality: sedimentary rocks are deposited horizontally; tilting indicates later deformation

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Principle of cross-cutting relationships: a feature that cuts another is younger than what it cuts

steps.body: Three stratigraphic principles: superposition, original horizontality, cross-cutting Index fossil criteria: short range, wide distribution, recognisable, abundant Radiometric dating: parent/daughter ratio + half-life = absolute age Relative dating = order only; Absolute dating = numerical age in years
